chunks: Yaqub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi Umayr from Rifa'ah and Ibn Bukayr from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): that he was asked about Hajj, is walking preferable or riding? So he said:
"Rather, riding, for indeed the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) performed Hajj while riding."

key_terms.صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: Peace be upon him and his family

ai.seo_question: Is it better to perform Hajj on foot or on a camel/horse according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the superiority of performing Hajj while riding, grounding the ruling in the Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). This ruling highlights the practical flexibility within Shia jurisprudence, prioritizing the ease of the pilgrim while maintaining fidelity to the Prophet's own conduct during the Farewell Pilgrimage.
